closingSelfCheck.summary: All 6 checklist items and every checked docs/behavioural promise are independently verified against live command output and source, not prose: commandSetDigest, freshnessBinding on both text/--json, the literal effectiveTier type, all six CLI registries, and the CHK-002:edge:0 waiver's three named fixtures all reproduce exactly as claimed. Adversarially: this record does NOT read cleaner than the story was -- it is unusually self-incriminating (F-008/F-009 is a reviewer correcting its own prior correction, F-019 through F-021 and F-024 through F-029 are a documented chain of the reviewers catching drift and overclaims in their OWN prior resolutions, and F-028/F-029 are honestly logged as accepted_risk rather than falsely marked fixed because rewriting commit history was correctly judged not worth invalidating every review-run binding on the branch). The one real gap I could not clear: nothing in process-events.jsonl, review-runs.json, findings.json or summary.json discloses WHY Codex is absent from the three PASSING review-escalation quorum rounds (which instead used claude+antigravity) -- the 'Codex hit its usage quota' explanation is not corroborated anywhere in the durable record, even though the underlying full-3x2 quorum gate itself is genuinely (not degradedly) satisfied by two distinct real hosts at current material, and Codex separately contributed 7 real fixed MAJOR findings across 4 independent cross-host rounds. plan.md CHK-001 also permanently carries a wrong design note that could not be amended post-DEV; this is disclosed (pitfall 6, F-017) rather than hidden, so I treat it as an accepted, honestly-flagged limitation rather than an unverified promise. Before DONE, the story owner should add one durable line (process-events.jsonl note or summary.json addendum) stating the actual reason Codex's rounds were not resubmitted as the passing quorum, since the current record leaves a real reader unable to distinguish 'quota outage' from 'quorum-shopping to a friendlier host' -- the gate is not gamed, but the omission is a legitimate honesty gap on a story that otherwise sets an unusually high bar for exactly this kind of disclosure.
